performance.verdict: Zero tracked leads across 28 days; spend throttle is intentional but intake gap makes scaling impossible.

findings.text: 28-day leads = 0 in pipeline data; Google Ads recorded 11 conversions on $1,016.18 spend, but GHL 500 error means none reached CRM — attribution is broken.
Booking bot battle-test was due 2026-07-31 and shows no completion event; with Vivian gone since 7/7, speed-to-lead automations point at an empty seat.
Spend collapsed to $19.43/day avg over last 7 days vs $43.09/day the prior 7 — a confirmed intentional throttle, but the scale-back-up gate cannot be cleared until intake ownership is confirmed.
GBP actions fell 69.77% week-over-week; last 3 days (Aug 26–28) show 3, 0, 0 actions vs 8, 0, 3 prior 3 days — organic visibility fading in parallel with paid pullback.
Meta spend = $0 across all 28 days and entire 45-day series; channel is dark, contributing nothing to lead volume.

suggestions.text: Resolve GHL 500 error immediately — 11 Google Ads conversions are not reaching CRM, making all lead tracking blind.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL is returning a 500 internal server error, meaning the 11 Google Ads conversions recorded in the 28-day window ($1,016.18 spend) are not landing in the pipeline. Escalate to GHL support or Nacer to restore the API connection. Success check: GHL pipeline reflects new inbound leads within 24 hours of fix — confirm by 2026-09-01.

suggestions.text: Confirm intake owner and GHL login replacing Vivian — speed-to-lead automations are pointing at a vacant seat since 7/7.
